critique.evidence: Strong, cohesive cyber-defense art direction: disciplined near-black palette, cyan/green/yellow accents, dramatic headline, restrained linework, and clear metric emphasis. Desktop feels polished, but the oversized hero creates excessive dead space and weakens the transition into the evidence panel. Mobile is notably denser: metadata, technical rows, and explanatory copy become very small, the badge wraps awkwardly, and the stacked card loses breathing room. The global header also degrades at tablet/mobile into a clipped horizontal rail with partially visible labels and no visible brand name on mobile. Contrast evidence for header links remains incomplete at tablet and mobile, so legibility is not fully proven.
critique.fix: Increase mobile supporting-text sizes and spacing, prevent the regression badge from wrapping, and simplify the compact header into an intentional menu or clearly scrollable rail with a persistent brand/current-section cue. Tighten desktop hero height and align its annotation more deliberately with the panel below; verify header-link contrast on the rendered gradient.
